Description: gets the logged-in user's info and the shops they belong to
Response: 200 {name, username, email, shops: [{id, name, role}]} / 401 not logged in

Description: creates an account and sends a verification email
Response: 201 created / 409 email or username taken / 422 invalid input
requierments: public. If an unverified account has the same email: overwrite it

Description: confirms the email. The email link opens a frontend page that sends the token here
requierments: public. Token stored in Redis with 24h TTL

Description: logs in and creates a session
Response: 200 + Set-Cookie (session id never in body) / 401 wrong email or password / 403 not verified / 429 too many tries
requierments: public. Account must be verified. Max 5 failed tries per 15 min (counter in Redis)

Description: deletes the current session from Redis and clears the cookie
deletes all sessions of this user (all devices)
emails a password reset link
Response: 200 always (never reveal if the email exists)

Description: sets a new password and logs out all devices
requierments: public. Token stored in Redis with 1h TTL

Description: creates a shop. The creator becomes the owner
gets shop details
renames the shop
gets the script snippet to paste into the shop's website
lists the team members
emails an invite link to a new agent
requierments: owner. Invite token in Redis with 7 day TTL

Description: joins a shop from an invite link
removes an agent from the shop
requierments: owner. Also clears that user's membership cache

Description: lists tickets with filters
Body: None (query params: status, assigned=me|unassigned, waiting_longer_than, cursor)

Description: gets one ticket with customer, messages and AI draft
changes status, assignee, priority or mood
Body: any of: status, assigned_to, priority, mood
requierments: member. Agents can only assign unassigned tickets to themselves. Owner can assign anyone

Description: agent replies to the customer or writes an internal note
requierments: member. Emails the customer (through the queue) unless is_internal. Updates last_agent_reply_at

Description: asks the AI for a new draft
lists the shop's help docs
adds a help doc for the AI
requierments: owner. Queues a job to prepare the doc for AI search

Description: edits a help doc
deletes a help doc
gets widget settings for the shop's website
customer starts a conversation (creates customer, ticket and first message)
customer reads their conversation
customer replies
requierments: conversation token. Reopens the ticket if it was closed

Description: checks that the API is alive (for monitoring)
